title: Leo the Lion
description: A young vegetarian lion is shunned by other carnivores.

title: Face the Music
description: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

title: Let Us In
description: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town.

title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
description: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony.

title: Time Freak
description: Dumped by his girlfriend, a young physics genius travels back in time to change the past and win her heart again.

title: I Can Only Imagine 2
description: After the success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame starts to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life.

description: Two wolves journey across the wilderness to find their smallest cub.

title: Apple Mortgage Cake
description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

title: Oddball
description: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.
